reason: Verification failed due to several major logic flaws that distort causality and metrics (module order, mandate lag, at-home enforcement, and double-counted observables). With two iterations remaining, a focused pass can correct these critical issues and materially improve correctness and downstream calibration.

specific_areas: Reorder modules: risk_signal -> mobility -> enforcement -> information -> social_influence -> adoption_decision -> retail_market -> aggregation
Fix enforcement applicability to exclude home: require valid non-home location for checks
Remove double-append of enforcement_events_daily and stockouts_daily (emit only from source modules)
Ensure enforcement_deterrence is visible to adoption the same day (ordering and/or buffer persistence)
Incorporate person.peer_influence_weight into adoption latent score
Adjust stockout metric to post-purchase (or clearly label pre vs post and choose one)
Add sanity tests for same-day mandate effects and no at-home fines

task_understanding.adjustments: Emphasize same-day causal flow: enforcement and mandate state must precede belief and adoption; observables should be single-source to avoid double counting.

data_analysis.adjustments: Add quick daily metric checks: verify enforcement_events_daily only increments once per day; confirm adoption rate responds on the same day to mandate/enforcement toggles.

model_planning.adjustments: Prioritize critical logic fixes and minimal tests this iteration; defer non-critical refactors (household init) if time-constrained; plan calibration only after metrics are trustworthy.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement module reordering; modify enforcement requires_mask logic; remove enforcement/stockout passthroughs from aggregator; scale peer term by peer_influence_weight; move stockout computation after purchases.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit/integration checks: (1) mandate_active toggled before info/adoption; (2) enforcement_deterrence present in buffers when adoption runs; (3) no fines when location_id == -1; (4) observables lengths match days and are not double-appended.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run short deterministic scenarios to validate: baseline vs enforcement-on day shows immediate adoption lift; confirm enforcement counts drop to zero when all at home.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Recompute adoption and enforcement trajectories post-fix; check for realistic ranges and absence of inflated totals; only then proceed to tune enforcement/fine parameters.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Report on each critical fix with before/after metrics (e.g., same-day adoption change, enforcement count at home=0) and confirm no observable double counting.
